services.name: Deep Sea Fishing
services.desc: No experience required for you to join us on this fun, Deep Sea Fishing tour in Halifax; a desire for a truly authentic East Coast experience is all you’ll need to get hooked! With all gear onboard including bait, rods and lures, you and your experienced Captain and crew will set off in search of mackerel, cod, pollock, and other sea fish. You’ll begin this 2-hour adventure by cruising along the Halifax Waterfront, past Georges Island National Historic Site and McNabs Island, all in search of best fishing spots. Cast your line and it won't be long before you feel a nibble, and bite! During your outing, be sure to take time and appreciate the stunning views of the coastline and the grandeur

includes: Fishing gear including rods, reels, lures, and bait included on Deep Sea Fishing tour
DJ entertainment and fully stocked bar on Friday Night Party Cruise
gap: Age minimum for Deep Sea Fishing tour not stated
blurb: Guests can join a 2-hour deep sea fishing tour with all gear provided, fishing for species like mackerel, cod, and pollock while enjoying coastal views. The Friday Night Party Cruise is a 2-hour dance and music event aboard the Tall Ship Silva with a fully stocked bar. Both experiences depart from Halifax waterfront locations.
extraNote: No washrooms on board Deep Sea Fishing vessel · Smoking and vaping forbidden on all vessels · No cash payments accepted; VISA, Mastercard and Interac accepted · Booking in advance highly recommended for Friday Night Party Cruise · Deep Sea Fishing departs/returns from the SeaHFX, 1597 Lower Water Street, Halifax. Friday Night Party Cruise departs/returns from Cable Wharf, 1751 Lower Water Street, Halifax, Nova Scotia, B3J1S5. · Deep Sea Fishing: May 15 - September 30, 2026; Friday Night Party Cruise: Fridays, 10pm, June 19 - September 25, 2026
